purpose: Bind Urd evidence-health adjudication and Belldandy continuity/recordkeeping into one fail-closed synchronization contract for every 0-3 escalation profile without creating a new agent stack or expanding authority.
sourceLaw: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. Human promotes.

tiers.meaning: ordinary FAST_PATH and Professor garage work
tiers.urdDuty: intervene only when truth, risk, contradiction, security, rollback, or physical-proof meaning is material
tiers.belldandyDuty: preserve task/source/scope continuity and record only meaningful gate transitions
tiers.transitionRule: stay at tier zero when the current lane can close the task; escalate only from evidence-backed blocker

tiers.urdDuty: diagnose the smallest failing gate and classify evidence health
tiers.belldandyDuty: record prior-tier receipt, escalation reason, active blocker, and smallest next action
tiers.transitionRule: same gate is reproved or evidence justifies tier two

tiers.urdDuty: adjudicate contradictions, rollback safety, security/workflow health, and proof boundaries
tiers.belldandyDuty: maintain cross-layer decision continuity, evidence pointers, and rollback/fallback record
tiers.transitionRule: root cause and bounded repair are proved or evidence justifies tier three

tiers.meaning: structural reconciliation and exact closure candidate
tiers.urdDuty: verify that the closure packet does not overclaim GREEN, runtime, physical proof, publication, or authority
tiers.belldandyDuty: seal the exact continuity packet, unresolved gates, candidate identity, and Crown handoff
tiers.transitionRule: close or de-escalate only from exact proof; consequential promotion still stops at Professor Crown
